comment: Two tool calls in ONE step, then a second step. This is the only fixture that emits parallel calls, so it is what exercises writeTranscriptToolLeadIn's blank-line-between-parallel-calls rule and the ToolCallHeaderRows preamble measurement (non-zero for the first call, zero for the second). Reads rather than writes: TTY tests run with cwd=ROOT, so a writing tool would litter the repo. Only the first call carries a rationale, so the test also pins that a call without one still gets its separator.
